scope: Durable shared admission barrier for guest/platform callback worker starts; bounded shutdown without late worker creation.

implementation.enter: Success holds a common Mutex across OS thread creation/start AND owner registry insertion; all success/error/rejection exits release it. Rejection is negative host ECANCELED.
integration: guest pthread_create with Android errno mapping
implementation.error_policy: Existing callbacks and TLS/global destructors may finish; late starts fail explicitly and cannot revive a worker after a subsystem join.
implementation.shutdown: as_worker_admission_begin_shutdown waits for earlier starts to finish registration, closes admission and returns before any joins; invoked after Java lifecycle outside VM lease.
exclusions: Runner watchdog does not execute guest callbacks.
Process-handle-copy receiver is synchronously joined inside its calling operation and does not execute guest callbacks.
implementation.source_audit: Both product and Switch-smoke link worker_admission.o. Runtime C stayed frozen during parent device build iteration10.
implementation.reset: Only successful END of as_native_reset calls as_worker_admission_reset; every early resource-reset failure leaves admission closed.

admission_cases: A real OS worker has started while threadStart return/owner registration is held; concurrent shutdown cannot return until registration completes.
Starts after shutdown reject before any additional threadCreate.
A TLS-destructor attempted worker start is rejected. Joining does not reopen admission.
Explicit reset after successful joins permits a new complete lifecycle.

display.admission: GLSurface start rejected without create/owned renderer, remains closed after quiescence, normal lifecycle works after explicit reset.

limitations: Host transport tests use real pthreads with fake libnx; no guest DEX/JNI execution.
OpenSL and guest-pthread gated starts are inspected and strict-target-compiled, not functionally executed by these host tests.
Early-return reset admission behavior is source-verified, not a host execution of native resource reset.
